contexts.text: Half a shekel () = the determination of the quantity.
A half number involves the same as a whole one... AC 5291.
To halve () = to divide into two, and thus to dispose themselves for reception.
The half of the Lord (would thus be adored).
Moses took half of the blood () = that the Divine truth was made of life and of worship. AE 329:6.
The half of a shekel in the shekel of holiness () = all things of truth from good. A half = all things... because the half of a shekel was ten gerahs... and by ten is signified all things...
The half of a shekel = all things of truth from good.

Half thereof, fifty and two hundred () = as much as is correspondent. A number which is the half of a preceding one = somewhat, and as much as is sufficient... When ten = all, then the half of it, or five = some; when ten = what is full, then five = as much as is sufficient; but when ten = much, five = somewhat... The case is the same with all other numbers, when they are halved... (Therefore) this number, which is the half of the preceding one, does not signify the half of the perception of interior truth... but as much as is correspondent...
Three and a half () = to the end and the beginning... Three = what is complete to the end; and a half = a beginning.

As it were half-an-hour () = the time corresponding, or the delay before all things were prepared to undergo the following changes. It is said half-an-hour, because a half and a half = as much as is correspondent, and as much as is sufficient; and an hour = delay.
A time, times, and a half = a full state of vastation.

1260 days make three years and a half... and by three and a half is signified the end of the former state and the beginning of a new one; here, the end of the former Church and the beginning of the New one... AE 658:2. AE 664.

Time = a state of good; times, a state of truth; both as to the implantation of them; and half a time = what is holy of the Church... The reason a half involves what is holy, is that three = what is full; in like manner three and a half, and seven; but seven = what is full when it treats of holy things, and this half after three fills it and makes up the number seven, because three and a half, doubled, are seven...
